lines.en: Grandma, can we make banana milk?
Sure. Bring the blender, please.
Where is it? I can't find it.
In the cabinet, under the sink.
Found it! Is the milk in the refrigerator?
Yes. I bought bananas this morning.
Should I open the jar of sugar?
Yes, please. Turn the lid slowly.
All mixed! Grandma, this tastes very good.
Thank you. I will wash the blender with the sponge.
Good afternoon. I need a new kettle.
Welcome. What happened to your old one?
lines.ko: 어서 오세요. 쓰시던 것은 어떻게 됐어요?

lines.en: Its lid broke last week.
Oh, I see. This kettle boils water fast.
lines.ko: 아, 그러시군요. 이 주전자는 물이 빨리 끓어요.

lines.en: It's nice. Can I use it on my gas stove?
Yes. It works on any stove.
Good. Do you sell sponges and jars?
Sure. These jars keep tea very well.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 이 병들은 차를 아주 잘 보관해요.

lines.en: I will take a tray too. Thank you.
Thank you. Please come again, Ma'am.
